name: Kesenya
description: Leader of the adventurers who triggered Emeria's defenses.

description_citations.text: "Rise of the Skyclaves". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nahiri meets Expeditionary House head Kesenya, who calls her Benefactor, and asks for a brave team.
timeline.quote: And now I need a brave and capable team to retrieve something very precious and very powerful.

citation.work: Episode 2: Race to the Murasa Skyclave
citation.text: "Episode 2: Race to the Murasa Skyclave" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Sep 2020.

timeline.summary: Zareth confides to Kesenya that he fears what the Core will do and asks her to find a buyer, planning to steal it.
timeline.quote: All I'm asking you to do is find a buyer for the Core who is rich and stupid.

citation.work: Episode 2: Race to the Murasa Skyclave
citation.text: "Episode 2: Race to the Murasa Skyclave" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Sep 2020.

timeline.summary: Jace discloses the situation to Kesenya, who refuses help but secretly writes Murasa on a note.
timeline.quote: But scrawled on the bottom of the parchment, there was a single word: Murasa .

citation.work: Episode 2: Race to the Murasa Skyclave
citation.text: "Episode 2: Race to the Murasa Skyclave" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Sep 2020.

timeline.summary: Kesenya's party activates Emeria's defenses and the Akoum fragments levitate again.
timeline.quote: its fragments began levitating once again

citation.text: "Akoum Skyclave", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kesenya's party triggers the Emeria Skyclave and the Murasa fragments begin levitating again.

citation.text: "Murasa Skyclave", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Skyclave's fragments levitate again after Kesenya's party activates Emeria's defenses.
timeline.quote: its fragments began levitating once again

citation.text: "Ondu Skyclave", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kesenya's adventurers inadvertently trigger Emeria's defenses, awakening six more Skyclaves.
timeline.quote: the adventurers inadvertently triggered the Skyclave's dormant magical defenses

citation.text: "Rise of the Skyclaves", section "The reawakening". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The adventurers retrieve relics and found the Sea Gate Expeditionary House, inspiring new expeditions.
timeline.quote: became the founding members of the newly founded Sea Gate Expeditionary House

citation.text: "Rise of the Skyclaves", section "Aftermath and impact". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The adventurers who breached Emeria form the Sea Gate Expeditionary House, secretly backed by Nahiri.

citation.text: "Tazeem", section "Zendikar Rising". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nahiri resolves to restore her spark and seek help from Kesenya.
timeline.storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
timeline.quote: Which meant, first things first, finding a way to restore her spark.

citation.work: March of the Machine: The Aftermath | Beyond Repair
citation.text: "March of the Machine: The Aftermath | Beyond Repair" by Emily Teng. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 May 2023.

relations.note: Kesenya addresses Nahiri as her benefactor and investor.
relations.quote: I'm pleased to see my investment is flourishing

citation.work: Episode 2: Race to the Murasa Skyclave
citation.text: "Episode 2: Race to the Murasa Skyclave" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Sep 2020.

relations.note: Nahiri helped Kesenya start her expedition house
